entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was preparing to sleep when the p..."
entries.dialogueText: I was preparing to sleep when the private phone in my living quarters rang.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew that if someone was calling..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew that if someone was calling at this hour, something urgent must have happened. The phone rang again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ringing sound felt off for some..."
entries.dialogueText: The ringing sound felt off for some reason. I knew something was wrong.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the phone. It was Hugo."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone. It was Hugo.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, my boy.""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, my boy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happened?""
entries.dialogueText: "What happened?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Oh, my nephew.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, my nephew."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Oh, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Are you sitting down?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sitting down?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please take a seat if you aren't.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please take a seat if you aren't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I sat down on the bed."
entries.dialogueText: I sat down on the bed.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Listen to me very carefully, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to me very carefully, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I received news from the frontline..."
entries.dialogueText: "I received news from the frontline..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's about Vina.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's about Vina."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It breaks my heart to inform you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It breaks my heart to inform you that your daughter, our Princess Vina has passed away during her captivity in Pales."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am so sorry, Romus. Truly. I can..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am so sorry, Romus. Truly. I can't even imagine--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I did not hear the rest of it. All..."
entries.dialogueText: I did not hear the rest of it. All I heard was the ringing of my ears. I dropped the phone on the ground.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I started breathing heavily. It fel..."
entries.dialogueText: I started breathing heavily. It felt like my heart was being squeezed with a wrench.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt helpless. I wanted to scream..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt helpless. I wanted to scream. I wanted to--

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was all in vain. Everything. My..."
entries.dialogueText: It was all in vain. Everything. My life. The crown.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My vision tunneled. I couldn't brea..."
entries.dialogueText: My vision tunneled. I couldn't breathe anymore. I fell down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I curled up on the chair."
entries.dialogueText: I curled up on the chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno rushed to my side and licked..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno rushed to my side and licked my face. I hugged him tight.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the phone. It was Hugo."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone. It was Hugo.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, my boy.""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, my boy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happened?""
entries.dialogueText: "What happened?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I was handling crown matters near..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was handling crown matters near the border when I received the news that Princess Vina and her rescuers had arrived from the front lines."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the faint voice of a woman..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the faint voice of a woman in the background.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father. It's me! Vina!""
entries.dialogueText: "Father. It's me! Vina!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm safe. We will soon fly to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm safe. We will soon fly to the palace."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Finally. I'm coming home!""
entries.dialogueText: "Finally. I'm coming home!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was laughing and crying at the..."
entries.dialogueText: She was laughing and crying at the same time.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Praise God!""
entries.dialogueText: "Praise God!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am so glad you are okay.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am so glad you are okay."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is so good to hear your voice.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is so good to hear your voice."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could feel my knees go weak. It w..."
entries.dialogueText: I could feel my knees go weak. It was really her.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And I am here with someone who has..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am here with someone who has been longing to speak with you for months."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed again."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you hurt? Did your captors hur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you hurt? Did your captors hurt you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I swear it on the name of House To..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear it on the name of House Toras. They will pay in blood."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what, you are safe now.""
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what, you are safe now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will make sure that your captors..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will make sure that your captors will be punished accordingly."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You don't know how good it is to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't know how good it is to hear your voice. After all this time in captivity..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No, I'm fine. They didn't dare lay..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I'm fine. They didn't dare lay a finger on the Crown Princess."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""War is war, Father. I'm sure Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "War is war, Father. I'm sure Rizia would have done the same or worse if we'd captured Duke Reinhart..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's Duke Reinhart you should puni..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's Duke Reinhart you should punish. Everyone else was just following his orders."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Listen, we have to go now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, we have to go now."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll see you in the morning, all r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you in the morning, all right?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father?""
entries.dialogueText: "Father?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I love you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could respond, the line dr..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could respond, the line dropped.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put down the receiver and sat on..."
entries.dialogueText: I put down the receiver and sat on the bed, my head still abuzz with the news.
